name: shahdara-team
summary: ONE orchestrator for OfferPk/shahdara-isp-billing, 6-slot rotation agent1 dashboard -> agent4 polish-qa -> agent2 mobile-nav -> agent4 -> agent3 forms-qa -> agent4 -> repeat, one at a time, each turn min 20 min and until its PR is merged. agent4 verifies and fixes existing features in a real browser (Playwright, 390x844 + 1280x800). Gate script: ticks never interrupt a run.
source: Copy of sidecars\shahdara-team\sidecar.json + shahdara-project\TEAM.md, TEAM_PROMPT.txt, team-gate.ps1, AGENTS.md, agentN\TASK.md from John's PC (updated 2026-10-17: agent4 polish-qa + browser verification rule). Not reconstructed.
schedule: CRON_TZ=Asia/Karachi every 5 min: team-gate.ps1 starts a new conversation ONLY if TEAM.lock is missing or older than 90 min (heartbeat after every step)
notes: Recommended Shahdara setup (sequential). Replaces the 3 parallel agents: never run it together with them or with shahdara-ui.
Gate log: shahdara-project\team-gate.log. To restart a stuck cycle at once: delete shahdara-project\TEAM.lock.
Turn order: 6-slot rotation in TEAM.md; shahdara-project\NEXT_AGENT.txt holds '<slot> <agent>' (e.g. '2 agent4'); per-turn log in TEAM_STATE.md.

agent4 (shahdara-polish-qa) keeps agent4\FEATURE_AUDIT.md (Works/Broken/Ugly per button) and adds Playwright e2e tests (tests/e2e/*.spec.mjs) + a CI e2e job. Covered by the existing sidecar grants (command(npx), command(npm), command(node), write_file on shahdara-project); no sidecar change needed.
